member.name: M:FoodAndDrink.DetailPage.OnFavoriteClicked(System.Object,System.EventArgs)
member.summary: Toggles the favorite status of the current item with haptic feedback.

member.name: M:FoodAndDrink.DetailPage.OnReadAloudClicked(System.Object,System.EventArgs)
member.summary: Uses Text-to-Speech to read aloud the item description and allergens. This fulfills the "specialist on-board mobile hardware" requirement (LO2).

member.name: M:FoodAndDrink.DetailPage.OnOrderClicked(System.Object,System.EventArgs)
member.summary: Opens a food delivery search for this item using the device browser. Falls back to a web search if the delivery platform deep link fails.

member.name: M:FoodAndDrink.DetailPage.OnDirectionsClicked(System.Object,System.EventArgs)
member.summary: Opens the device's native maps app with a search for this item's location. Uses Map.OpenAsync with the item's subtitle (city/region) and name. Falls back to web maps if native maps are unavailable.

member.name: M:FoodAndDrink.ExplorePage.OnCameraScanClicked(System.Object,System.EventArgs)
member.summary: Opens the device camera to capture a photo of a dish. Uses MediaPicker API with permission handling.

member.name: M:FoodAndDrink.ExplorePage.OnBarcodeScanClicked(System.Object,System.EventArgs)
member.summary: Navigates to the barcode scanner page which uses ZXing to read barcodes/QR codes via the device camera.

member.name: M:FoodAndDrink.ExplorePage.OnPopularSeeAllClicked(System.Object,System.EventArgs)
member.summary: Navigates to the full item list sorted by rating when "See All" is tapped in the Popular This Week section.

member.name: M:FoodAndDrink.ExplorePage.OnClearRecentClicked(System.Object,System.EventArgs)
member.summary: Clears all recently viewed items from the tracked list.

member.name: M:FoodAndDrink.FavoritesPage.OnExploreDishesClicked(System.Object,System.EventArgs)
member.summary: Navigates to the explore page when the "Explore Dishes" button is tapped in the empty favorites state.

member.name: M:FoodAndDrink.MainPage.StartShakeDetection
member.summary: Starts listening to the accelerometer for shake gestures. When a shake is detected, triggers a random food recommendation. This fulfills the "specialist on-board mobile hardware" requirement (LO2).

member.name: M:FoodAndDrink.MainPage.ShowShakeRecommendation
member.summary: Picks a random item and shows it as a shake-based recommendation.

member.name: M:FoodAndDrink.ScanPage.OnFlashlightClicked(System.Object,System.EventArgs)
member.summary: Toggles the device flashlight on/off for barcode scanning in low light. Uses the Flashlight API — counts as mobile hardware usage.

member.name: M:FoodAndDrink.ScanPage.OnBarcodesDetected(System.Object,ZXing.Net.Maui.BarcodeDetectionEventArgs)
member.summary: Handles barcode detection events from ZXing camera view. On first detection, vibrates, stops scanning, and shows the scanned value.

member.name: T:FoodAndDrink.Services.CategoryService
member.summary: Provides read access to the Categories table. Categories are seeded once at database creation and are read-only at runtime.

member.name: T:FoodAndDrink.Services.DatabaseService
member.summary: Manages the SQLite database lifecycle: creation, table setup, and seed data. Registered as a singleton in DI to ensure a single database connection path.

member.name: M:FoodAndDrink.Services.DatabaseService.GetDbAsync
member.summary: Returns an initialized SQLite connection, creating tables and seeding data on first access. Uses double-check locking to prevent race conditions during concurrent initialization.

member.name: M:FoodAndDrink.Services.DatabaseService.GetConnectionAsync
member.summary: Provides access to the initialized database connection for other services.

member.name: M:FoodAndDrink.Services.DatabaseService.SeedDataAsync(SQLite.SQLiteAsyncConnection)
member.summary: Seeds the database with 7 food categories and 32 food items representing authentic Chinese cuisine across different price tiers. Only runs when the Category table is empty.

member.name: T:FoodAndDrink.Services.FoodItemService
member.summary: Business logic layer for food items: CRUD, search, filter, sort, favorites management, and recently-viewed tracking. All methods return empty collections on failure rather than throwing, ensuring the UI degrades gracefully.

member.name: M:FoodAndDrink.Services.FoodItemService.SearchAsync(System.String)
member.summary: Searches items by keyword across Name, Cuisine, and Subtitle fields. Returns all items if keyword is empty.

member.name: M:FoodAndDrink.Services.FoodItemService.ToggleFavoriteAsync(System.Int32)
member.summary: Toggles the IsFavorite flag on a food item. Inverts the current state.

member.name: M:FoodAndDrink.Services.FoodItemService.ClearRecentlyViewedAsync
member.summary: Clears the ViewedAt timestamp on all items, resetting the recently-viewed list.

member.name: M:FoodAndDrink.Services.FoodItemService.FillIconEmojiAsync(System.Collections.Generic.List{FoodAndDrink.Models.FoodItem})
member.summary: Populates the IconEmoji property on each item by looking up its category. Fails silently — emoji is a cosmetic enhancement.

member.name: T:FoodAndDrink.Services.LocationService
member.summary: Provides location-based services: retrieving the device's current GPS position and calculating distances using the Haversine formula. Part of the "mobile hardware" requirement — geolocation counts as a sensor feature.

member.name: M:FoodAndDrink.Services.LocationService.GetCurrentLocationAsync
member.summary: Requests location permission and retrieves the device's current GPS coordinates. Returns null if permission is denied, GPS is unsupported, or an error occurs.

member.name: M:FoodAndDrink.Services.LocationService.CalculateDistance(System.Double,System.Double,System.Double,System.Double)
member.summary: Calculates the great-circle distance between two geographic coordinates using the Haversine formula. Returns distance in miles.
